text: In the epilogue, Cohen learns at a cemetery that Luca has died, but the rest of his family survived.
Cohen visits his mother Esme, who is catatonic, but she briefly regains awareness long enough to tell him she loves him.
Cohen helps his father Pieta repair the front door of their home, though conversation between them remains difficult.
Cohen announces he is leaving Veil Sangora, and Pieta gives him his blessing.
Cohen finds Luca alive in a mountain cave, transformed into a Muron rather than dead as everyone believed; this transformation was Brenis's farewell gift to Cohen, sparing her instead of killing her.
Nebaru gives Cohen a letter with instructions and says they must leave the valley immediately before snow buries the mountain passes.
Nebaru stays behind to deal with the chaos left by Brenis and his servants, promising that in time no one will remember Brenis's name.
That same night, Cohen loads Luca into a wagon and leaves the valley.
In the Lakra ending route, when Nebaru comes to the cave, Lakra arrives with him and reveals she works for the Council of Augers, who sent her to deal with Brenis.
In the turncoat ending, Brenis honors the bargain and returns Cohen's family, and the story moves to Lasa instead of a final battle.
In the turncoat ending, Cohen never confronts Brenis in Anahora and never kills him.
In the turncoat ending, Brenis remains in power and continues extracting blood from the valley for his larger plan, while Lasa receives special privileges including permission for Christianity.
The epilogue of the turncoat ending states that Brenis's regime eventually collapses because of the arbiters, meaning Cohen's choice only delays rather than secures Brenis's rule.
In every ending route, Luca is transformed into a Muron and Nebaru eventually comes for Cohen, who enters the service of the Council of Augers.
